transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I suppose… it’s got to the point where I’m arranging things at home around avoiding spiders. I put off going down to the basement for laundry, I avoid the garden shed, and sometimes I pay someone to do small jobs I could do myself, just so I don’t have to go into those places.
When you see a spider, do you feel an immediate surge of fear?
Yes. It’s very quick. My chest tightens, my hands start shaking… and I usually just freeze or get out of there before I’ve really thought about it.
Is your fear limited to spiders?

Yes… it’s really spiders. I know, rationally, one sitting in the corner of an old house probably won’t hurt me. But if I picture one dropping out of a box or being near the washer, it just feels… huge and threatening. Embarrassingly so.
